name: notion-paper
description: Collaborative paper-reading workflows for a structured Notion reading journal.

interface.shortDescription: Polish and maintain structured paper notes in Notion.
interface.longDescription: Start a paper from its PDF, initialize a reading-journal entry, process individual reading sections, answer inline questions, add requested formulas or child pages, and safely commit reviewed drafts.
defaultPrompt: Start a paper-reading task from the attached PDF.
Polish the current paper section in my Notion journal.
Commit the reviewed draft for the active paper section.
